meta.headline: A neutral verification layer for multi-party oil & gas fiscal operations
meta.standfirst: Dextrum reads the systems each party already runs, re-derives allocation, lifting and valuation under the agreed terms, and gives every party one tamper-evident record to check: per-period, at close.

founder.name: Jamal Kamaludin, Founder
founder.detail: · 40+ years oil & gas (EXXON, DIALOG Group); BSc Chem Eng, UK ’82. MBA, France 2024
founder.geography: Malaysia · Australia · Saudi Arabia · S Korea · USA.

columns.heading: Assurance stops at the party boundary
columns.deck: For the parties who settle fiscal outcomes across company boundaries:

items.label: OPERATOR
items.body: Computes the number inside its own systems, on its own boundary.

items.label: PARTNER
items.body: Re-derives alone, from statements, over the same evidence.

items.label: REGULATOR · AUDITOR
items.body: Sampled look-back, months after the exposure opened.

foot.body: The systems work, but the number is computed on a system owned and operated by the party being audited. Proof arrives slow, manual and after the fact.

columns.heading: A read-only layer above your systems
columns.deck: Nothing replaced, nothing re-keyed, no new system of record for the operator to run.

items.label: OPERATOR · PARTNER · REGULATOR · AUDITOR
items.body: All verify the same result at the same moment.

items.label: ONE NEUTRAL RECORD · TAMPER-EVIDENT
items.body: SHA-256 provenance · exceptions raised at close, evidence attached.

items.label: DEXTRUM · THE VERIFICATION LAYER
items.body: Re-derives the result under the agreed arrangement · stamps provenance.

foot.body: Your systems produce the data; Dextrum turns it into continuous, audit-defensible evidence, mappable to ISAE 3000.

columns.heading: CEEP: the encoded control library
columns.deck: Four decades of operator-side fiscal practice, written down as deterministic controls.

items.title: Controls
items.body: Does the number follow the agreed basis?

items.title: Evidence
items.body: Every figure traced to its source record.

items.title: Provenance
items.body: Tamper-evident stamp every party can check.

blocks.body: AI explains: labelled advisory, never in the verification path. Above all parties: owned by none, verifiable by all.

blocks.lead: Built and live: a working MVP.
blocks.body: C-001 founder-validated on a simulated Malaysian PSC scenario; C-002 and C-003 mechanism-validated against spec. Fiscal first. CCUS MRV at the point of CO₂ injection follows.

blocks.label: THE THREE-DIMENSION TEST
blocks.body: Continuous means every record, every period. No incumbent category passes all three.

lines: Your systems already produce the numbers. Dextrum turns them into proof every party can check.
Each period closes with its evidence in place.
